authority: ADR-0005: Native NetCDF-4 Float32 is the sole scientific authority. Visualization bricks are approximate rendering products.

thetao_fulldepth.float16_justification: 0.0078125 C is well within the 0.01 C accepted uncertainty for NWP ocean analysis products and is invisible at oceanographic scales.
thetao_fulldepth.valid_zero_risk: LOW: 0.0 C is a valid ocean temperature in polar regions. Uint16 code for 0.0 C with offset=-2.0 is 3124 (well away from 65535).
thetao_fulldepth.missing_code_collision_risk: NONE: Valid thetao maps to [0, 65533] at worst; 65534 is reserved margin; 65535 is missing.

so.float16_justification: 0.004 salinity units is below the noise floor of any operationally relevant salinity gradient.
so.valid_zero_risk: MEDIUM: Salinity of 0.0 is physically valid in freshwater-dominated coastal zones. Uint16 code for 0.0 with offset=0.0 is 0. This is SAFE (0 != 65535). Confirm offset is set to 0.0 or negative to ensure 0.0 maps away from 65535.
so.quantization_domain_note: Must cover [0.0, 42.0] safely. Recommended scale = 42.0/65534 = 0.000641. Missing code 65535 is safe as valid range [0,42] maps to [0, 65533].

physical_range_m_per_s.note: Typical CMEMS global surface currents; deep currents may be smaller. Exact range REQUIRES_VERIFICATION from actual data.

uo.float16_justification: Sub-millimeter-per-second precision is far below any meaningful current detection threshold.
uo.uint16_affine_note: Symmetric range requires offset. Recommended: offset=-4.0, scale=8.0/65534=0.0001221. Then u=0.0 maps to 32767 (safe, far from 65535).
uo.valid_zero_risk: HIGH: Exactly 0.0 m/s is physically common (quiescent deep water, calm surface). With offset=-4.0 and scale 0.000122, u=0.0 maps to Uint16 code 32767. This is SAFE. Must verify offset is correctly applied.
uo.missing_code_collision_risk: NONE with symmetric offset. Valid range maps to [0, 65534]; 65535 reserved.
uo.vector_safety_rule: If EITHER uo OR vo has validity_mask != 0 at a grid cell, BOTH components are treated as invalid for any vector computation. No partial vectors.
uo.validity_mask_semantics: 0=valid_ocean, 1=source_missing_or_fill, 2=land. Must be IDENTICAL mask for uo and vo at every grid cell.

vo.uint16_affine_note: Same symmetric quantization policy as uo. Must use identical scale and offset as uo to enable joint rendering.
vo.valid_zero_risk: Same as uo: HIGH concern, safely handled with symmetric offset.
vo.validity_mask_semantics: Must be bitwise-identical to uo validity mask per grid cell.

physical_range_m.note: Typical SSH anomaly range for this domain. Exact range REQUIRES_VERIFICATION.

zos.float16_justification: Sub-millimeter SSH precision is sufficient for all visualization and inspection purposes.
zos.uint16_affine_note: Symmetric range. Recommended: offset=-2.0, scale=4.0/65534=0.0000610. zos=0.0 maps to 32767 (safe).
zos.valid_zero_risk: HIGH: SSH anomaly of 0.0 m is common. Safely handled with symmetric offset.
zos.field_type_note: zos is 2D (time x lat x lon only). Its Uint16 missing code (65535) represents masked land cells in the 2D surface mask. No depth dimension.

global_rules: Uint16 code 65535 is reserved as the missing value sentinel across ALL variables. No valid quantized value may map to 65535.
Float16 NaN represents missing/invalid in Float16 bricks. No valid physical value should round to NaN.
Valid physical zero MUST NOT be treated as missing. Validity comes from the validity_mask field, not from checking if the value equals zero.
Error statistics (max, MAE, RMSE, p50, p90, p95, p99, p99.9) must be measured per-variable, per-depth, per-timestamp in TASK-12C.
Approximate visualization bricks are NOT the authority for scientific analysis. All exact queries must use native NetCDF-4 sources.
